AppendWithoutIdemKey.because: A paid step adds its ledger line without looking for its idempotency key, so a retry or a second job with the same step key adds a second line for one provider call.

IdemKeyWithoutStep.because: The idempotency key does not name the step key, so the second paid step of a job looks already charged and its cost is never recorded.

IdemKeyWithJob.because: The idempotency key names the job as well as the step key, so a second job with the same inputs adds a second ledger line for a step that was served from the cache.

CallWithoutCacheCheck.because: A paid step calls the provider without looking in the cache for its step key, so a retry or a second job with the same inputs pays the provider again.

VerifyWithoutStateCheck.because: Verify accepts any job that has an output from an earlier attempt, so a job is marked verified on a stale output while its retry has not rendered.

ClaimWithoutStateCheck.because: A render claims a job without checking that it is waiting, so two renders work on the same job at once.

RecoverWithoutLockCheck.because: Recovery marks a rendering job failed without checking that its render has stopped, so the job leaves the rendering state while a render is still working on it.
